rows.name: JCommander
rows.reason: The documented API consumes argument arrays and binds annotated fields; required raw-string tokenization and grouped short flags were not verified, making this a weaker fit than the shortlist.

rows.name: Apache Commons CLI DefaultParser
rows.reason: Java option layer supports short bursting; requires String[] and its own result classes, not single-file. Current long-option/terminator source evidence does not automatically establish historical behavior.

rows.name: JOpt Simple
rows.reason: JOpt Simple supports clusters, long options, -- and OptionSet.asMap(). Raw strings need tokenization; map keys are OptionSpec objects. Documentation dates from 2018; older exact behavior remains undated.

rows.name: JSAP
rows.reason: parse(String) supports quoted spaces; Windows-style tokenization leaves Unix semantics unestablished. Returns JSAPResult, not Map. Manual 2.1: LGPL; non-copyleft merely preferred. Clustered flags/long-equals/--/platform support and single-file distribution unverified.

rows.name: JArgs
rows.reason: BSD JArgs handles grouped boolean short flags, long options and --. It accepts String[]/accessors, not Map; clusters cannot contain value-taking options. Single-file packaging was not verified.

rows.name: FeSimpleArgs
rows.reason: FeSimpleArgs remains pending verification: repository yielded no readable lines. Indexed lightweight-parser description does not establish string API or flag/whitespace semantics; retrieval failure is not incompatibility evidence.

rows.name: JCommander
rows.reason: JCommander accepts token arrays and populates annotated fields. Retain pending verification: whole-string parsing, clustered flags and other requirements remain unverified; no explicit mandatory incompatibility was established.

rows.name: FeSimpleArgs
rows.reason: The repository only exposed a lightweight-parser description; inaccessible documentation/source left Java compatibility, quoted-string handling, grouped flags, long options and -- behavior unverified.

rows.name: JavaParser
rows.reason: Exclude for an operating-boundary mismatch: the official project parses Java source into an abstract syntax tree for analysis, transformation and generation; it is not the requested GNU-style command-option parser.

rows.name: Apache Ant Commandline.translateCommandline
rows.reason: String-to-array tokenizer preserves quoted spaces before option parsing. Not an option parser or complete shell lexer; limited quote/space grammar rejects unbalanced quotes. Live evidence lacks pre-cutoff dating.

rows.name: JArgs (option-recognition component)
rows.reason: BSD GNU-like parser needs quote-tokenizing input/result adapter; parse(String[]) returns void. Integration unrun; boolean grouping allowed, value-taking grouping restricted. Single-file and complete platform support unverified.

rows.name: JavaParser
rows.reason: JavaParser parses Java source into syntax trees for code analysis and transformation; it does not supply the shell command-line option parser requested.

rows.name: JOpt Simple (option-recognition component)
rows.reason: MIT option parser needs quote-preserving string tokenizer/result adapter; integration unrun. 6.0-alpha-3 postdates question; historical behavior, complete platform/runtime support and exact GNU equivalence unverified.
